name: Connaught Place & Janpath Heritage Circle
advisory_text: High police patrol frequency, well-lit pedestrian corridors, dedicated 24/7 Tourist Police Kiosk in Inner Circle block. Be mindful of minor touts near underground Palika Bazaar claiming special shopping festivals.
source_label: Official NCRB District Record & Delhi Police Advisory
recommendations: Safe for walking at night; use official prepaid auto booths located near Rajiv Chowk Metro Gate 7.

name: Chandni Chowk & Old Delhi Rail Corridor
advisory_text: Extremely high pedestrian and rickshaw density. Frequent reports of inflated transport fares for foreign visitors and unauthorized guides offering 'exclusive rooftop views'.
source_label: Official NCRB District Record & Delhi Police Advisory
recommendations: Keep bags zipped in front. Book e-rickshaws or walk the newly pedestrianized heritage promenade. Avoid dark side lanes (katras) after 21:00.

name: Paharganj / NDLS Railway Station Main Exit
advisory_text: Documented hotspot for auto-rickshaw fare inflation and 'hotel has burned down / closed' diversion tactics to commission hotels.
source_label: Official NCRB District Record & Delhi Police Advisory
recommendations: Ignore unsolicited agents on footbridges. Only use the Delhi Traffic Police Prepaid Taxi/Auto Counter on Ajmeri Gate / Paharganj sides or app cabs.

name: Mehrauli Archeological & Qutub Environs
advisory_text: The main Qutub Minar complex has comprehensive CISF and Delhi Police security. Mehrauli Archeological Park has dense greenery; stick to marked paved trails during daylight.
source_label: Official NCRB District Record & Delhi Police Advisory
recommendations: Use metro (Qutub Minar station on Yellow Line) or official app cabs. Exit park premises by 18:00.
